tuples.subject: penal_interest
tuples.special_circumstance: penalty for non-compliance of material Penal Charges in loan terms and conditions
tuples.quote: Penalty, if charged, for non-compliance of material Penal Charges in Loan terms and conditions of loan contract by the Accounts borrower shall be treated as ‘penal charges’ and shall not be levied in the form of ‘penal interest’ that is added to the rate of interest charged on the advances.

tuples.subject: penal_capitalisation
tuples.special_circumstance: capitalisation of penal charges (no further interest computed on such charges)
tuples.quote: There shall be no capitalisation of penal charges i.e., no further interest computed on such charges.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.special_circumstance: REs introducing additional component to the rate of interest
tuples.quote: The REs shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest and ensure compliance to these guidelines in both letter and spirit.

tuples.subject: penal_charges
tuples.special_circumstance: quantum of penal charges must be reasonable and commensurate, and not discriminatory within a particular loan/product category
tuples.quote: The quantum of penal charges shall be reasonable and commensurate with the non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract without being discriminatory within a particular loan / product category.

tuples.subject: penal_charges
tuples.special_circumstance: loans sanctioned to ‘individual borrowers, for purposes other than business’
tuples.quote: The penal charges in case of loans sanctioned to ‘individual borrowers, for purposes other than business’, shall not be higher than the penal charges applicable to non-individual borrowers for similar non-compliance of material terms and conditions.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.special_circumstance: clear disclosure of quantum and reason for penal charges by REs in loan agreement and most important terms & conditions
tuples.quote: The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by REs to the customers in the loan agreement and most important terms & conditions /
